name: lingoloop
description: LingoLoop Monorepo — Frontend (Next.js), Backend (Express + Supabase), AI (Gemini)

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const services = [['AI', 'AI'], ['BACKEND', 'Backend'], ['FRONTEND', 'Frontend']]; const procs = services.map(([label, dir]) => { const p = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', dir, 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); p.on('exit', code => { if (code) console.error('[' + label + '] exited with code ' + code); }); return p; }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { procs.forEach(p => p.kill('SIGINT')); process.exit(); });"
scripts.env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); [['AI/.env.example','AI/.env'],['Backend/.env.example','Backend/.env'],['Frontend/.env.example','Frontend/.env.local']].forEach(([src,dst]) => { if (!fs.existsSync(dst)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); console.log('+ Dibuat:', dst); } else { console.log('= Sudah ada:', dst); } });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix AI install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix Frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix Frontend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:ai && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
